title: Build a Modifier Order Lab
prompt: Create paired examples showing padding/background, clip/clickable, size/requiredSize, and offset differences, including semantic bounds.
successCriteria: Each pair explains the wrapper order.
Touch and accessibility bounds are inspected.
The reusable sample accepts caller Modifier correctly.
hints: Begin with immutable state and a stateless content composable.
Verify one lifecycle, configuration, or rapid-interaction edge case before polishing visuals.

starterCode.code: @Composable fun ModifierCase(title: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, content: @Composable () -> Unit)

solutionOutline: Define the state, events, ownership boundary, and UI contract.
Implement the smallest correct flow, then exercise every success criterion.
verification: Run focused state and interaction tests.
Inspect semantics and the relevant lifecycle or runtime behaviour.
